text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary group 'wave-b' exceeded 5xx threshold: 12m window, 8.9% errors. Paging eng-oncall.
jen: I saw the pager. Can anyone confirm which model/route?
omar: Looks like rollout of rollout-2026-03 flagged to wave-b only. Route /v1/generate -> model: opt-13b-quant.
linh: Observed increased 502s from the frontend proxies to runtime nodes, likely OOM or kernel mismatch. Logs: ```runtime: kv-cache miss then oom-ish token allocation failure```
sam: I can check node metrics. Pinged autoscaler and starting a quick grep on 502 traces.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout ID r-2026-03-19-21 initiated at 3579123000 by @linh. Current traffic 10% -> wave-b. Canary abort criteria met: aborting further rollout.
jen: Good. Is abort flip automatic or do we need to flip the feature flag?
deploy-bot: Policy: abort=true for this job, automatic rollback to previous routing variant in 30s unless overridden.
omar: Hold - customers on Dedicated might be pinned to the new variant, double-checking routing table.
linh: I'm seeing degraded KV-cache hit rates on those GPUs, and quantization codepath error logs on a subset of instances. Suspect binary/kernel mismatch after image push.
sam: Node group g-wave-b-3 shows elevated GPU mem usage + oom_killer events at 21:50 UTC. Stack traces attached in logs channel.
jen: Ok plan: 1) Confirm abort completes 2) flip traffic to stable immediately if abort lagging 3) run quick smoke on stable route 4) notify support for customers and create incident ticket.
jen: @sre-lead can you start mitigations if abort doesn't finish?
sre-lead: On it. If abort not completed in 2m, I'll run `routing set wave-b=0 --force` and pin capacity to stable. Also watch for cascading evictions.
linh: Executing manual kill-switch: `/flag rollout-2026-03=false --scope=wave-b` (will take effect across control-plane).
deploy-bot: Feature flag rollback acknowledged. Rolling back traffic.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-264 at 3579123500 - Severity: P2 - Customer impact: possible increased latency and 5xx for a subset of requests.
omar: Manual routing change in progress: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/reconfig -d '{"wave-b":0}'` - response ok.
sam: Smoke results: stable route serving generation test cases end-to-end, latency within normal, no 5xx on test traffic.
jen: Good. Sam please keep 1:1 monitoring on request rate and 5xx for the next 30m. Also dump a small sample of error payloads to the ticket.
linh: I've pinned the candidate image and flagged it for rollback in the registry. Will start a narrow rebuild for the quantized kernels.
sre-lead: Noted. Also scaling g-wave-b nodes down to drain; starting node drain sequence to avoid churn.
omar: Customer impact assessment: internal metrics show 2000 requests failed across 18 customers in the 12m window. No enterprise customers with Dedicated capacity affected (they were on stable). Notifying support with details.
jen: @support please send an advisory to affected customers: short note + ETA on investigation. Include that rollback occurred and we will follow up.
linh: Root cause hypothesis: new runtime image had an optimized kernel that regressed on certain GPU drivers causing allocation errors under kv-cache heavy workloads. Repro plan on staging with same driver matrix.
sam: Alarms quieting: global 5xx rate down to baseline after routing flip. Monitoring looks stable.
jen: OK, closing immediate paging loop. Next steps: postmortem owner? I'll take action item to write incident writeup, include rollout configs, canary thresholds, and recommend tightening abort criteria for quantized builds.
sre-lead: Assigning follow-ups: 1) linH - kernel repro and fixed image; 2) omar - add extra pre-canary smoke for kv-cache heavy paths; 3) jen - postmortem + customer comms; 4) sam - validate autoscaler safe drain flows.
omar: One more: add a short-circuit that reduces canary percent to 0 instantly on control-plane abort (to avoid 30s window). Filing ticket.
jen: Thanks all. Handoff to next oncall in 40m: leave summary in #incidents and mark INC-2026-264 assigned.
incident-bot: Handoff noted. Next oncall: @maria.
jen: logging final notes in ticket and will update thread when postmortem draft ready. :white_check_mark:
